value.evidence: Partially conforms to WCAG 2.2 Level AA (vendor-reported; report scope excludes course units and third-party content). TalentLMS publishes an ACR/VPAT based on VPAT 2.4, report dated 19 June 2025. Vendor says partial WCAG 2.2 AA conformance; report validity stated as June 2025–June 2026, so request a refreshed report for current procurement.

security.notes: Request current SOC 2/ISO security evidence and scope; do not assume certifications without the current Trust Center documents.

value.notes: Cloud-hosted; available data regions and tenant selection require vendor confirmation. Confirm hosting region, subprocessors, data retention, support access and AI processing in the DPA.
